build.buildCommand: npm install && npm run build && curl -L https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest/ffmpeg-master-latest-linux64-gpl.tar.xz -o /tmp/ffmpeg-full.tar.xz && mkdir -p ffmpeg-bin && tar -xJf /tmp/ffmpeg-full.tar.xz -C ffmpeg-bin --strip-components=1 && chmod +x ffmpeg-bin/bin/ffmpeg && rm /tmp/ffmpeg-full.tar.xz
